pool.text: Sultan Majid bin Said of Zanzibar began building Dar es Salaam city very close to Mzizima.
Dar es Salaam fell into decline following the death of Majid bin Said.
The German East Africa Company established a station to revive Dar es Salaam.
The Royal Navy bombarded Dar es Salaam city with the monitor Mersey.
The town of Dar es Salaam became a municipality with nominated councillors.
Tanganyika achieved independence from colonial rule after political developments.
Tanganyika and Zanzibar merged to form Tanzania while Dar es Salaam remained capital.
The Tanzanian government declared the ujamaa policy making Tanzania lean towards socialism.
Provisions were made to relocate the capital city from Dar es Salaam to Dodoma.
Business Times was established as the first private financial and economic newspaper.
Dar es Salaam was managed by the Dar es Salaam City Council until June.
Mama Africa school was founded to train professional acrobats.
The trans-Indian Ocean backbone cable SEACOM was installed to improve internet access.
The Mikocheni ward had a population of 32,947 according to the census.
The 35-storey PSPF Tower was finished in the city skyline.
The Tanzania Ports Authority Tower was completed as the country's tallest building.
The bus rapid-transit system Phase 1 began operation on May 10.
A scientist made a breakthrough discovery of hominid footprints in Northern Tanzania.
Paul Makonda serves as the commissioner of Dar es Salaam Region.
Flooding displaced 1,215 households in Dar es Salaam.
